title: Comparison of Two Strategies for Surfactant Prophylaxis in Premature Infants
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether the immediate bolus strategy combined with early nasal CPAP (nCPAP) treatment could decrease the subsequent need for ventilation compared to the administration of surfactant prophylaxis at 15 minutes after birth with early nCPAP in premature infants.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Premature infants born before 28 weeks' gestation
* Premature infants born at 29 to 30 weeks' gestation who did not receive antenatal steroid were randomized before delivery

Exclusion Criteria:

* Infants died at delivery room
